global.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
global.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
global.summaryEn: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

global.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
global.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.
global.summaryEn: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

global.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
global.summary: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

global.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
global.summary: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.
global.titleKo: 구글, 빠르고 보정된 멀티모달 판단 'Gemini Decisions API' 공개
global.summaryKo: 구글이 자사 모델 Gemini Decision 기반으로 빠르고 보정된 멀티모달 의사결정을 제공하는 Gemini Decisions API를 공개했다.
global.summaryEn: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by its Gemini Decision model, for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.
